items.exampleEn: In biology class, we learned how evolution works.
items.exampleZh: 我們在生物課上學到演化是怎麼進行的。

items.exampleEn: Many young people want job stability more than a high salary.
items.exampleZh: 許多年輕人比起高薪，更想要工作穩定。

items.exampleEn: The children watched the formation of clouds over the mountain.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們看著山上的雲慢慢形成。

items.exampleEn: Some apartment buildings have a restriction on keeping large dogs.
items.exampleZh: 有些公寓大樓限制住戶飼養大型狗。

items.exampleEn: The bank expects inflation to stay low next year.
items.exampleZh: 銀行預計明年的通貨膨脹會維持在低點。

items.exampleEn: The city spends a lot of money on crime prevention.
items.exampleZh: 市政府花很多錢在預防犯罪上。

items.exampleEn: The new battery is a revolutionary design.
items.exampleZh: 這款新電池是一項革命性的設計。

items.exampleEn: His first impulse was to laugh, but he kept quiet.
items.exampleZh: 他的第一個衝動是想笑，但他忍住沒出聲。

items.sentenceEn: The museum shows the evolution of cars over the past century.
items.sentenceZh: 這間博物館展示了汽車在過去一百年來的演變。

items.audioEn: Prices have gone up a lot this year because of inflation, so we need a bigger budget.
items.audioZh: 因為通貨膨脹，今年物價漲了很多，所以我們需要更多預算。

items.sentenceEn: Fire prevention is everyone's job in this building.
items.sentenceZh: 在這棟大樓裡，防火是每個人的責任。

items.sentenceEn: Try not to make big decisions on impulse.
items.sentenceZh: 盡量不要一時衝動做重大決定。

items.stemEn: New ____ on parking mean that visitors can only stay for two hours.
items.stemZh: 新的停車限制規定，訪客停車最多兩小時。

items.stemEn: Her ____ idea of letting customers pay what they want surprised everyone.
items.stemZh: 她讓顧客自由決定付多少錢的革命性點子，讓大家都很驚訝。

items.passageEn: For many years, our town enjoyed economic stability. Then inflation rose sharply, and the cost of food and rent went up almost every month. The local government introduced restrictions on rent increases, which helped families temporarily. A young engineer then proposed a revolutionary plan: a community farm where people could grow their own vegetables. The formation of the farm took a year, and many people joined on impulse after seeing it on the news. Experts say the farm is an interesting step in the evolution of city life, and it also helps with the prevention of food waste.
items.passageZh: 多年來，我們的小鎮經濟一直很穩定。後來通貨膨脹急遽上升，食物和房租的費用幾乎每個月都在漲。地方政府推出限制房租漲幅的規定，暫時幫了各個家庭一把。後來，一位年輕工程師提出一個革命性的計畫：一座讓居民種自己蔬菜的共有農場。農場花了一年才成形，很多人在新聞上看到後，一時衝動就加入了。專家說，這座農場是城市生活演變中有趣的一步，也有助於防止食物浪費。

questions.questionZh: 物價上漲時，地方政府做了什麼？
那位年輕工程師提出了什麼計畫？
options: 讓居民買便宜蔬菜的購物中心
讓居民免費搭的公車路線
讓居民自己種菜的共有農場

items.promptZh: 這些新限制都只是暫時的。
referenceEn: All of these new restrictions are only temporary.
These new restrictions are just temporary ones.
rubricZh: restriction 是可數名詞，這裡用複數（例如 these restrictions）
「暫時的」可寫 temporary 等；「只是」可寫 only、just 等

items.promptZh: 她一時衝動把頭髮剪短了。
referenceEn: She cut her hair short on impulse.
On an impulse, she had her hair cut short.
rubricZh: impulse 常用，例如 on impulse、on an impulse 等，可放句首或句尾
「把頭髮剪短」可寫，例如 cut her hair short、had her hair cut short 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式
